name: decode_flagged_packed_chunk
description: Decodes one step of a packed stream: it reads a flag bit from a bit reader, copies a run of earlier output bytes backward when the flag is set, and returns once the output pointer passes its limit.

name: spin_short_delay_loop
description: Counts a short register down from three to minus one with no other work and returns, so it only consumes a few cycles as a pause.

name: read_bits_into_register
description: Shifts bits out of a stored longword one at a time into a bit buffer, consuming as many bits as the count register requests and returning when that count is reached.

name: shift_out_packed_bits
description: Pulls bits off a bit register one at a time, and when the register is empty it loads the next 16-bit word from the input pointer, moving that pointer backward.

name: check_stream_flags_only
description: Tests whether a counter register is zero and the low bit of a pointer is clear, then returns; it changes no memory and no state beyond the processor flags.

name: test_pointer_low_bit
description: Tests the lowest bit of a 16-bit address register and returns; it writes nothing to memory or hardware.

name: stub_return_only

name: shift_bit_buffer_by_count

name: decode_packed_match_chunk
description: Main unpacking loop: it decodes a match length and distance from the bit reader, copies that run of earlier output bytes backward, optionally copies a second run from the input, and returns once the output pointer reaches its limit.

name: resume_packed_decode_loop
description: Alternate entry into the packed-data decoder that reads a length value and copies a run, then loops back into the same copy routine until the output limit is reached.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes here do not decode to a valid instruction, so there is no real routine; the only path ends in an invalid decode and the entry is a stub.

name: poll_status_until_complete
description: Repeatedly clears a state variable, calls three bit-level helpers in turn, and returns once a completion condition is set; it also busy-waits on a status value before looping again, with the CIA port A register carrying fire buttons and disk status.

name: store_five_return_mask
description: Stores the value five into one state variable and returns a fixed 32-bit mask whose upper sixteen bits are set and lower sixteen bits are clear.

name: spin_forever_without_work
description: Infinite do-nothing loop with no calls or memory accesses; control never returns, so it acts as a permanent trap.

name: advance_state_copy_columns
description: Advances a small state counter that wraps at seven, then copies a column of bytes from one buffer into another in three strided passes chosen by the state, returning immediately when the state is zero.

name: init_button_input_state
description: Clears button state variables, calls the pot-port setup routines, configures the pot direction register for mouse input, and stores the fire and right/middle button readings into state bytes.

name: split_input_word_flags
description: Reads a 16-bit input word from the structure pointed to by the address register, splits selected bits into one-bit state flags, and combines two bit pairs with exclusive-or to form two derived values.

name: track_mouse_position_deltas
description: Reads the mouse-port movement counter register, subtracts the previously stored counter values to get horizontal and vertical deltas, and applies each delta to a position variable clamped between its stored minimum and maximum.

name: pass_value_through_unchanged
description: Returns the value already in the data register without changing it, with no memory or hardware effect.

name: return_low_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the low eight bits of the data register as its result and changes nothing else.

name: copy_cell_block_or_init
description: When the state variable holds its expected value, it calls a setup routine several times and writes fixed field values into a record; otherwise it copies a 4-by-3 block of 16-bit words from a source buffer into a destination and clears the state variable.

name: draw_character_glyph_rows
description: Maps an incoming character to a glyph index, where a space clears eight rows of a buffer and a digit or letter selects a glyph whose bytes are copied into those rows, with a bracket character remapped first.

name: init_work_tables_and_flags
description: Sets several working variables and flag fields, scans a length table for its largest entry, and zeroes a chain of fourteen fixed-size entries.

name: advance_audio_channel_state
description: Advances the playback state of four audio channels each time it is called: it writes the DMA enable bits, moves each channel's data pointer and volume along, and on a counted step loads the next pattern entry and clamps the per-channel values to their limits.

name: step_channel_sequence_entry
description: Processes one entry of a sequenced channel stream: a special end marker stores the next delay value and returns, while any other entry looks up a table row by a nibble index and updates that channel's pointer, length and volume fields.

name: extract_nibble_from_state
description: Masks a state variable down to four bits and shifts them into the low bits, then returns the caller's data register unchanged.

name: copy_large_block_to_memory
description: Copies a large block of longwords from a source pointer into low memory in one loop, then calls the follow-up routine and returns the byte it produces.

name: unpack_magic_tagged_block
description: When the data begins with a fixed magic word, it reads a size from the header, copies that many bytes into a fixed buffer in a backward pass, and then runs a second copy pass; without the magic word it does nothing.

name: decode_packed_stream_loop
description: Main unpacking loop for a flagged bit stream: it reads a flag bit, copies a backward run of earlier output when the flag is set, and repeats until the output pointer reaches its limit, calling the bit readers for each decision.

name: return_fixed_identifier_tag
description: Returns a fixed four-byte tag value in the result register, reading no inputs and changing no memory.

name: process_flagged_input_byte
description: When a status flag from a call is set, it sets a control bit, derives a value from an inverted input byte through a comparison chain into a state variable, waits through a short countdown, clears the control bit, and stores eight into a count field.

name: raise_trap_fifteen
description: Executes the trap instruction for vector fifteen and returns; the trap is the entire behaviour of the routine.

name: forward_single_call_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns, passing control through without any other work.

name: check_status_then_jump
description: Calls two setup routines, then compares a status word against two expected values; on a match it calls two more routines and jumps to a fixed entry address, and otherwise it returns.

name: call_then_indirect_dispatch
description: Calls two routines, then jumps indirectly through a pointer that could not be recovered from the listing, so the target of that jump is unknown.

name: call_then_indirect_dispatch
description: Calls two routines, then jumps indirectly through a pointer that could not be recovered from the listing, so the target of that jump is unknown.

name: jump_if_status_matches
description: Calls one routine, then compares a status word against a fixed value; on a match it calls another routine and jumps to a fixed address, and otherwise it returns.

name: call_table_entry_at_offset
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer read from a table pointed to by a global, at a fixed offset, then returns.

name: toggle_bit_and_scramble
description: Toggles one bit in a byte array at a computed offset, sets a bit in a second array, XORs a stored longword with a fixed constant, copies a byte between buffers, and returns a combined byte value.

name: wait_until_status_bit_clears
description: Busy-waits while one bit of a status variable stays set, then returns.

name: wait_until_status_bit_clears

name: call_table_entry_at_offset
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer read from a table pointed to by a global, at a fixed offset, then returns.

name: call_and_complement_result
description: Calls three routines in sequence, then returns the bitwise complement of the last result in the high half of the return value and leaves the other half unchanged.

name: call_and_complement_result
description: Calls three routines in sequence, then returns the bitwise complement of the last result in the high half of the return value and leaves the other half unchanged.

name: configure_bitplane_control_registers
description: Writes a fixed value to the bitplane control register and clears the first bitplane modulo register, setting the display mode for the bitplane hardware.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it does no work.

name: call_two_routines_then_return
description: Calls two other routines in order and returns the value that was already in the data register; it adds no computation of its own.

name: call_table_entry_at_offset
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer read from a table pointed to by a global, at a fixed offset, then returns.

name: call_table_entry_at_offset
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer read from a table pointed to by a global, at a fixed offset, then returns.

name: iterate_nine_digit_keys
description: Loops over the nine digit keys from one to nine, calling two routines for each key, and returns the result of the first call made on the last pass.

name: call_and_pass_registers
description: Calls one other routine and returns the two data register values it was given, so the caller's register values pass through unchanged.

name: run_text_entry_loop
description: Initialises the display registers and a screen-state record, then reads key codes: digit keys select a numbered slot, typed characters are stored, and confirm or cancel codes leave the loop and restore the saved state.

name: edit_save_slot_description
description: Runs the save-position screen: digit keys choose one of nine slots and typed characters are written into that slot's description, with Return confirming and Esc cancelling; the slot's name is restored on exit.

name: resume_slot_description_editing
description: Resumes description editing for the current save slot: when the buffer is non-empty and a flag is set it deletes trailing characters, then reads keys to append text and redraws the slot line until a confirm or cancel code ends the entry.

name: erase_then_edit_description
description: Clears the trailing characters of the description buffer and then reads keys to edit it, redrawing the slot line after each change until a confirm or cancel code is received.

name: load_slot_name_for_edit
description: Copies the stored slot name into the edit buffer, then reads keys for digit selection and text editing, redrawing each line; confirm and cancel codes exit to the caller.

name: prompt_save_confirmation
description: Shows the confirmation step of a save: it clears any pending character, copies the slot text into the edit buffer, and reads keys until Return confirms, a digit selects another slot, or Esc cancels.

name: finish_save_screen_state
description: Ends the save screen by counting a counter down to zero, setting a pending-flag byte, and restoring the stored display state before returning.

name: blit_shifted_bitmap_rows
description: Draws shifted rows into a bitmap buffer: for each row it reads a source word from a table, shifts it by a bit offset, combines it through a mask into the destination words, and advances to the next row.

name: clear_longword_block
description: Zeroes a block of 2560 longwords starting at a pointer read from the frame, then returns the data register value it was given.

name: call_three_routines_return
description: Calls three other routines in order and returns the data register values it was given, adding no computation of its own.

name: select_populated_load_slot
description: Sets up the display registers, then waits for a digit key naming a slot that holds a save; Return or Esc leaves the loop and restores the saved display state, and the choice is checked against a table of filled slots.

name: check_savegame_present_prompt
description: Checks whether a save is present for the chosen slot: if none exists it shows the no-savegame message and waits for any key, otherwise it waits for a digit key that selects a filled slot, returning on Esc.

name: select_load_slot_and_confirm
description: Runs the load-position screen: digit keys choose a slot and Return confirms the load, while Esc cancels and restores the display state before returning.

name: await_load_slot_choice
description: Waits for a digit key that selects a populated load slot, with Return confirming and Esc leaving the screen, then restores the stored display state.

name: finish_load_screen_state
description: Ends the load screen by counting a counter down to zero, setting a pending-flag byte, and restoring the stored display state before returning.

name: finish_load_screen_state
description: Ends the load screen by counting a counter down to zero, setting a pending-flag byte, and restoring the stored display state before returning.

name: initialise_save_area_marker
description: Checks whether the save area already carries its four-character marker; if it does it returns a failure code, otherwise it clears a block of 103 longwords, writes the marker and returns success.

name: reset_save_area_marker
description: Clears a block of 103 longwords in the save area and writes the four-character marker unconditionally, then returns success.

name: call_offset_routine_then_clear
description: Sets a status word, calls a routine through a computed offset from a base table, restores the status word, and clears two longword fields of the frame-linked record.

name: spin_on_frame_byte
description: Polls a byte in the stack frame in a loop whose condition compares that byte with itself, so the listing shows no exit and the routine waits on that location.

name: run_flagged_text_entry_loop
description: Sets up the display and interrupt control registers, then runs the key-entry loop for slot text: digit keys choose a slot, Return and Esc end the loop, and the argument selects one of two entry modes.

name: restore_saved_display_state
description: Writes saved values into the custom display and interrupt control registers, stores the saved display state, and returns the caller's data register.

name: read_keyboard_serial_key
description: Reads a keyboard code from the keyboard serial register, inverts and rotates the raw byte, looks it up through a dispatch table, stores the decoded key, and performs the CIA handshake before returning.

name: set_fixed_bits_in_byte
description: Sets a fixed bit pattern in the low byte of the data register and returns it, with no other effect.

name: clear_frame_flag_bit
description: Clears the lowest bit of a flag byte in the stack frame and returns, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: copy_value_and_toggle_pending
description: Copies a longword from the stack frame into a record field; when a pending byte is set it toggles that byte's low bit and calls a routine, then sets a counter field to thirty-two.

name: wait_for_flag_toggle
description: Spins until the lowest bit of a status variable is clear, then spins until it is set again, and returns; it performs no other work.

name: call_sequence_return_value
description: Calls two routines, captures the value returned by a third, calls a fourth, and then returns the captured value.

name: wait_until_target_word_matches
description: Chooses the larger of two 16-bit values as a target and keeps calling a routine until its returned value equals that target, then returns the input value unchanged.

name: poll_until_value_matches
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until its 16-bit result equals the value in the low half of a data register, then returns.

name: wait_until_max_value_reached
description: When two 16-bit values differ, it takes the larger as the target and calls a routine until its result equals the value in the second register.

name: poll_until_registers_match
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until the low word of one data register equals the word in the other data register, then returns.

name: toggle_bitmap_bit
description: Calls a routine to get a bit number, then flips that bit in a bitmap, using the number divided by eight as the byte index and counting bits from the most significant end of each byte.

name: draw_centered_text_string
description: Clears 80 longwords of a line buffer, measures the zero-terminated string, computes a centred start position from its length, and draws each character through a glyph routine, advancing six units per character.

name: draw_string_from_position
description: Computes a start position by halving the input value and offsetting it, then draws each character of the zero-terminated string through a glyph routine, advancing six units per character.

name: draw_zero_terminated_string
description: Calls a routine for each character of a zero-terminated string in turn until the terminating zero byte, then returns.

name: advance_string_draw_position
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until the byte at the string pointer is zero, then returns the last result advanced by six.

name: blit_shifted_bitmap_rows
description: Draws shifted rows into a bitmap buffer: for each row it reads a source word from a table, shifts it by a bit offset, combines it through a mask into the destination words, and advances to the next row.

name: return_constant_hundred

name: call_boot_helper_routine

name: decrement_saturating_counter_byte

name: set_value_and_increment_count

name: countdown_and_patch_if_matched

name: update_flag_bit_two
description: When the input is zero it sets bit two of a flag byte and reports whether that bit was previously clear; otherwise it clears that bit when a code word matches and reports the result.

name: add_saturating_counter_byte

name: fill_entries_with_increasing_values
description: Writes a run of table entries: each entry stores a 16-bit code and the high and low halves of a running longword, which advances by the input step each time; the run length comes from the input count.

name: copy_words_into_longword_table
description: Copies a run of 16-bit words into a table of longwords, placing each word in the high half and adding a fixed step to a running value on each iteration; the count comes from the input argument.

name: pack_nibbles_into_longword_table
description: Reads groups of three words, packs nibbles taken from their high bits into a longword, and stores each packed longword in a table, adding a fixed step to a running value on each iteration; the count comes from the input argument.

name: store_indexed_table_entry

name: unlink_list_node

name: clear_flag_and_dispatch

name: drain_list_with_callback

description: Clamps the two input coordinates to non-negative values and to limits held in the structure, stores them, then loops making a fixed sequence of indirect calls and writing small fields on each pass.

name: run_fixed_indirect_call_loop
description: Loops making a fixed sequence of indirect calls, writing a few fields and pointers into the frame on each pass, and calling a routine that sets up the next step.

name: write_offset_values_to_table
description: Copies the top bit of a global status variable into a flag byte, runs several routines when the lowest flag bit is set, and writes a starting value plus fixed offsets into alternating entries of a table.

name: countdown_and_dispatch_once
description: Counts a flag byte down by one while it is non-zero and, when it reaches zero, calls an indirect routine once.

name: fill_three_slot_address_table
description: When a flag bit is set, it walks three slots from the top down, computes an address for each from a per-slot code value, and writes the high and low halves of that address and of the address 68 bytes further on into the slot.

name: clear_masked_bits_in_list
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of byte pointers, each paired with a 16-bit mask, and clears the masked bits in each addressed byte.

name: swap_lists_and_set_bits
description: Swaps two list pointers held in the structure, then walks the new active list, setting the paired 16-bit mask bits in each addressed byte until a null pointer ends the list.

name: seed_particle_records_from_beam
description: Fills a table of particle records with values derived from the low byte of the beam position register combined with a running value, reduced modulo a fixed range and shifted by per-record amounts.

name: advance_records_into_table
description: Advances a list of moving records by their per-record velocities, clears records that leave the visible range, and writes each active record's position into a table using a second table of values indexed by the fractional part.

name: step_counter_and_write_pattern
description: Advances a stepped counter from a source value toward a target and, on each due step, reloads the step interval and writes a patterned set of table words for that step position, calling an indirect routine when a secondary counter expires.

name: step_counter_and_write_words
description: Advances a stepped counter toward a target and, on each step, writes a patterned set of table words and reloads the step interval.

name: call_stored_function_pointer
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer held in a fixed memory cell, then returns.

name: call_slot_and_return_eight
description: Calls an indirect routine through a fixed slot, then returns the fixed value eight.

name: patch_if_check_words_match
description: If two global values match fixed expected values, it writes a fixed code word and a pointer into the structure and calls an indirect routine; it then sets a global mask.

name: install_jump_patch_and_call
description: Stores a fixed value in a structure field, writes a jump code word and address into two patch locations, then calls an indirect routine through a slot.

name: install_patch_pair_by_match
description: Writes jump code words and addresses into fixed patch locations, choosing one set when a global value matches a fixed value, then performs a bounds check that raises a trap on failure; the listing ends in invalid decoded data.

name: write_patch_words_and_call
description: Writes fixed code words and a jump address into several memory locations and then calls the routine stored in a global pointer.

name: write_patch_words_and_call
description: Writes fixed code words and a jump address into several memory locations and then calls the routine stored in a global pointer.

name: set_global_and_return_constant
description: Stores a fixed constant in a global variable and returns a fixed 64-bit constant pair in the result registers.

name: set_global_and_return_constant
description: Stores a fixed constant in a global variable and returns a fixed 64-bit constant pair in the result registers.

name: initialise_highscore_buffer
description: Writes a marker word into the buffer and copies a fixed block of 180 bytes of default data after it when the stored high-score file is absent or invalid, returning the input data register.

name: initialise_highscore_buffer
description: Writes a marker word into the buffer and copies a fixed block of 180 bytes of default data after it when the stored high-score file is absent or invalid, returning the input data register.

name: initialise_highscore_if_absent
description: Calls a check routine and, when it reports that the high-score file is absent, writes a marker word and a fixed block of 180 bytes of default data into the buffer and calls an indirect routine; otherwise it calls a different indirect routine and returns its input.

name: write_default_highscore_block
description: Writes a marker word and a fixed block of 180 bytes of default data into the buffer, then calls an indirect routine, and returns the second input.

name: call_indirect_routine_slot
description: Calls an indirect routine through a fixed slot and returns the input registers unchanged.

name: run_boot_exec_io_setup
description: Boot-block entry that prepares an I/O request structure and calls exec library routines through the library base, including the DoIO and SuperState functions; it then makes three further calls and ends on undecodable data.

name: unpack_signed_data_block
description: Checks a four-byte header signature at the start of the loaded data; when it matches, it reads the packed and unpacked sizes and the stream, then copies the unpacked output into the destination with bounded buffer checks, calling four other routines.

name: find_code_table_match_value
description: Scans a table of word pairs until a masked input equals the stored second word, then combines a bit count from the matching entry with an indexed value and returns the resulting bit mask, calling another routine when the entry needs a sub-table.

name: apply_mask_and_conditional_call
description: Ands an input word with a mask, and when a byte comparison fails it calls another routine and uses its returned word as the result; otherwise it returns the masked word.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it does no work.

name: read_four_bytes_big_endian
description: Reads four consecutive bytes from the pointer in the address register and assembles them into one 32-bit value in the data register, shifting each new byte in at the low end so the first byte becomes the most significant.

name: build_prefix_code_table
description: Reads a count and a list of code lengths, then builds an entry for each symbol holding a mask, a bit-reversed code and the symbol's length, forming a prefix-code lookup table.

name: step_through_eleven_wide_rows
description: Splits a position value into a quotient and remainder by eleven, derives a stride from a size bit, then steps through a counted run of cells in chunks of up to eleven, accumulating the steps taken until the count runs out or a flag ends the run, and returns the combined position.

name: read_disk_sector_with_retry
description: Reads a disk sector up to four times: it clears the header fields, writes the MFM sync pattern and sync word into the buffer, runs the disk routines, and returns success when the sector checks match, otherwise a status code.

name: start_disk_dma_and_wait
description: Sets the disk DMA length and pointer registers, enables disk DMA and the disk interrupt, and repeatedly configures the timer registers until the ready flag clears or the retry count runs out.
